fundoscopy: normal

mental status / cognitive screen: normal
muscle tone examination: normal
limb strength (MRC) examination: normal
deep tendon reflexes and plantar responses: normal
sensory examination (pinprick, vibration, proprioception): normal
coordination examination (limb and truncal): normal
posture and pull test: normal

MRI orbits: SEVERE THINNING of all extraocular muscles; exotropia of the right eye
MRI brain with contrast: no lesion, no cranial nerve enhancement
7. Thyroid function tests (TSH, free T4) and thyroid antibodies
thyroid function (TSH, free T4): normal
anti-thyroid antibodies: normal
